resources.string: Run your appointment business from your phone
Keep your calendar, clients, services and team in one place, and let your clients book with you directly. Made for salons, studios, clinics, tutors, repair shops and anyone who works by appointment.
Create, reschedule, complete or cancel appointments, mark no-shows, and browse your calendar and history.
Clients request a time that suits them. Approve or decline each request in one tap.
Keep a client list with contact details, or import clients straight from your phone\'s contacts.
Describe what you offer with prices and durations, grouped into categories, in your own currency.
Invite employees with a code, choose which services each of them performs, and manage their access.
See today\'s business at a glance, and switch between businesses if you run more than one.
BookkMe holds data about you, your team and your clients, so privacy is built in rather than added on.
No analytics or advertising SDKs. Crash reporting is off until you turn it on.
Export your personal data or your whole business as a file, at any time.
Choose how long finished client records are kept before they are erased.
Sign in with passkeys, with no password to leak or forget.
BookkMe — a source-available booking app for Android and iOS.

I lost my phone or can’t find my passkey

Passkeys are usually synced to your Google or Apple account, so try another device where you’re signed in to it. If no passkey is offered when you sign in, check that the device has a screen lock turned on. If you still can’t sign in, write to support from your account’s email address.
How do I export my data?

For your personal data, open Settings › Account › Export my data. If you own a business, open its dashboard and choose Data export. Confirm with your passkey, and download the JSON file once it’s ready.
How do I delete my account?
Open Settings › Account › Delete account and confirm. Deletion is permanent and can’t be undone. If you can no longer sign in, write to legal@bookkme.com from your account’s email address.
How do I add an employee?
Generate a code with Invite employee and share it. Your employee enters it with Join business in the app. If the code is lost, revoke it and create a new one.
How long are client details kept?
Each business chooses 12 to 120 months under Client data retention in its settings. After that, client details on ended appointments and requests are anonymized or deleted.
Does the app send crash reports?
Only if you turn on Send crash reports in Settings › Account › Privacy. Reports contain technical details about the error and your device, not your name, email, business or client data.
